name: Canvas Status Bar
description: Status bar widget for the canvas area. Populates the #statusbar div with zoom display (percentage + lock/unlock SVG icon, clickable to toggle zoom lock), locked indicator, workspace path display, and a 'view all' button that triggers fitAll(). Initialized once into the existing #statusbar element.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Populate #statusbar with zoom/locked/workspace/view-all elements (idempotent if already populated)

methods.name: update
methods.signature: (locked: boolean, scale: number, workspaceName: string, onLockToggle: (() => void) | null, fitAll: () => void) => void
methods.description: Refresh all displayed values and wire click handlers
